run_DocLM_perplexity: run the DocLM transformer to compute perplexity scores for documents using KenLM language models
run_SentencePiece_tokenize: run the SentencePiece transformer to tokenize document text using a SentencePiece model
run_MultiSentencePiece_multilang: run the MultiSentencePiece transformer to tokenize documents across multiple language-specific SentencePiece models
run_PerplexityBucket_classify: run the PerplexityBucket transformer to classify documents into head, middle, or tail perplexity buckets
run_perplexity_to_bin: run the perplexity_to_bin function to compute perplexity scores and write them to a binary file
